prose: Meta's announcement rolls out real-time voice conversation with Muse, previewed at Connect 2026, in the Muse app on mobile, web and Mac; tap the phone icon to start. Meta pitches thinking out loud, planning trips while walking or cooking, and rehearsing interviews or pitches. An avatar reacts with expressions and gestures; users choose voice only, side by side or full screen, and pick from hundreds of voices (a New Yorker, a pirate). It uses Muse Realtime Avatar and Realtime Voice technology.
highlights: Real-time voice with Muse on mobile, web and Mac
Expressive avatar: voice only, alongside or full screen
Hundreds of voices to choose from
Use cases: trip planning, interview and pitch rehearsal
